title: Dataset Versions By Root Response
description: GET /api/v1/datasets/versions/by-root/{dataset_root}. Success envelope (response_handler.success_response): {success, message, data: {dataset_root, versions}}. Resolves a server-computed dataset_root (MultisetRootV1) to the caller's dataset versions whose stored identity has that root, newest first (TraigentBackend src/routes/dataset_version_routes.py get_dataset_versions_by_root). Each entry is exactly DatasetVersionV1 without content_snapshot; no content identity, per-example map or public_input_digest is carried here. A root matching no version the caller may read is 404, indistinguishable from an unknown root.

dataset_root.description: The root from the path, echoed.

versions.description: Every readable version whose stored dataset_root equals the requested root, across the caller's datasets, newest first. Never empty (an empty match is 404).

x-backend-obligations: The lookup is tenant-scoped by the canonical tenant context and by the root's key id; each match is returned only when its parent dataset passes the same owner-scoped load as every other dataset route.
Entries never carry content_snapshot (DatasetVersionV1 without the include=snapshot projection).
